title: Clinical Evaluation of a Paediatric Sleep Diagnosis Technology
official: Clinical Evaluation of a Paediatric Sleep Diagnosis Technology
summary:
The objective of this project is to gather research data and subsequently evaluate algorithms to demonstrate clinical efficacy of a novel sleep apnoea detection system in the paediatric population.

The Study will involve patients who will have been referred for diagnosis of sleep apnoea, and the ultimate aim will be to compare the output of a novel apnoea detection system against in -clinic polysomnography or cardio-respiratory polygraphy, assess acceptance of the novel system in the home environment, assess validity in patients on ventilation, and on a cohort with BMI SDS of 3 or more.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Children older than one year old (older than eight years old for studies at-home) and below 18 years of age.
* Children who have been referred to a sleep clinic due to suspicion of sleep apnoea.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients whose parents/legal guardians/carers are not fluent in English, or who have special communication needs.
* Known allergy to the adhesive dressing.
* Patients with physical or mental impairments who would be too distressed with additional sensors on themselves.
* Patients with not enough space on the neck area to fit the sensor.
* Clinical problem in the area in which the device will be attached, eg skin condition ●. For patients conducting the study at home, patients with neurocognitive impairments which may increase the risk of them putting the sensor in their mouth, who do not have overnight carers
